user_approval: okej kontynuuj: continue the proposed bounded GPU metadata repair and validation, without training or final evaluation
question: Can a narrowly scoped trusted NVIDIA metadata subprocess return complete identified GPU driver, clocks and load under the sanitized worker environment, while incomplete probes fail closed?
cohort_status: maintenance; not executable or approved for scoring
inherits: PC-01-CONTRACT-V1 model, train/dev/final split, source, recipe, controls, quality thresholds, 5000 updates, selection rule and resource/attempt limits remain unchanged.
sole_measurement_change: Require validated, time-stamped GPU metadata before fit and after timing for v3 only; preserve legacy v1/v2 schemas, result interpretation and receipts without retroactive requirements.
implementation: Keep the candidate/worker sanitized environment unchanged. Only the nvidia-smi child may receive a registry-derived ProgramW6432 path on Windows.
Use a bounded five-second read-only query; record command, executable, timestamp, elapsed time, return code, stdout/stderr and explicit failure details. Never silently accept null metadata.
Require one identified GPU with UUID, name, driver, positive SM/memory clocks, utilization in 0..100 percent, nonnegative memory use, and matching identity across snapshots.
Write failure evidence before rejecting a prospective v3 run; pre-fit failure must not start training. Post-timing failure makes the prospective measurement inconclusive.
Do not rewrite completed EXP results or refill their missing historical driver/load snapshot. Do not implement a final-series authority or evaluator-compatibility exemption in this maintenance stage.
validation: Pure fixtures for complete and malformed CSV, missing executable, timeout, NVML failure, missing field, nonfinite/negative values, multi-GPU ambiguity, device identity drift and missing metadata.
Verify environment copy isolation and that ordinary candidate subprocess policy remains byte-identical.
Run at most three paired real nvidia-smi probes inside fresh sanitized subprocesses: original probe versus repaired helper; no model import, data access or training. Preserve all outcomes.
Exercise prospective worker pre-fit rejection and parent completeness gate using synthetic fixtures only; legacy completed records must still validate.
Full regression, immutable history/ledger-prefix verification, new evaluator freeze and conformance certificate, doctor PASS; maintenance must deny dev/final/replay/legacy/series freeze.
decision: Keep only if all required positive/negative checks pass. Otherwise preserve failures and report the bounded blocker. Completion returns to PC-01-DECISION and grants no training.
